## Overview

## Perception Benchmarks

```
# MMBench multiple-choice evaluation\nresults = []\nfor q in benchmark.questions:\n    prompt = format_mcqa(\n        image=q.image,\n        question=q.question,\n        choices=q.choices\n    )\n    pred = model.generate(prompt, max_new_tokens=10)\n    answer = extract_choice(pred)  # parse 'A'/'B'/'C'/'D'\n    results.append(answer == q.answer)\nprint(f'Accuracy: {sum(results)/len(results):.1%}')
```

## Reasoning and Hallucination

```
# POPE hallucination probe\nhallucination_count = 0\ntotal = 0\n\nfor obj, present in ground_truth.items():\n    q = f'Is there a {obj} in the image?'\n    response = model.generate(q).lower()\n    predicted_yes = 'yes' in response\n    # Count false positives (model says yes, object is absent)\n    if predicted_yes and not present:\n        hallucination_count += 1\n    total += 1\nprint(f'Hallucination rate: {hallucination_count/total:.1%}')
```

## Benchmark Saturation

```
# Test for option bias vs genuine visual reasoning\ndef test_option_bias(model, questions):\n    standard_acc = evaluate(model, questions)\n    # Swap the correct answer to a different choice position\n    swapped = swap_answer_positions(questions)\n    swapped_acc = evaluate(model, swapped)\n    drop = standard_acc - swapped_acc\n    if drop > 0.20:\n        print(f'Option bias detected: {drop:.0%} accuracy drop')\n    return drop
```

| Benchmark | Task | Size | Top model % | Saturated? | Measures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| VQAv2 | Open-ended VQA | 214K | 86.1 | Yes | Perception |
| MMBench | MC Questions | 3K | 88.4 | Partial | Multi-ability |
| MMMU | Multi-discipline | 11.5K | 73.3 | No | Knowledge+Reasoning |
| SeedBench | Multi-dimension | 19K | 77.7 | No | Perception+Cognition |
| HallusionBench | Hallucination | 1.1K | 63.8 | No | Faithfulness |
| MMStar | Balanced VQA | 1.5K | 71.8 | No | Multi-step Reasoning |

## Robust Evaluation Practices

```
# LLM-as-judge evaluation (GPT-4V)\nscores = []\nfor sample in eval_set:\n    prompt = build_judge_prompt(\n        question=sample.question,\n        reference=sample.reference_answer,\n        prediction=sample.model_output\n    )\n    rating = gpt4v(prompt, image=sample.image)\n    score = parse_score(rating)  # {'accuracy': 8, 'detail': 7}\n    scores.append(score)\nmean_score = sum(s['accuracy'] for s in scores) / len(scores)\nprint(f'Mean accuracy score: {mean_score:.1f}/10')
```

> **warning**: Many VLM benchmarks are now saturated — top models exceed 85% on VQAv2. Prefer recently released benchmarks (MMMU, MMStar) that require genuine multi-step reasoning and are not yet in pretraining corpora.
